$comment: Standing platform test checklist — area ledger. Hand-edited, append-only; validated by scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs (pnpm check:platform-checklist). Authoring rules: docs/qa/platform-checklist/README.md · execution protocol: RUNNER.md.
title: Platform core — boot, health, console shell

items.title: Showcase boots clean: health 200, no degraded startup banners
preconditions: isolated run per dogfood-verification §0: own free port, own file DB (--seed-admin -d file:/tmp/<run>/data.db)
steps: boot examples/app-showcase via `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port

acceptance.clause: GET /api/v1/health returns 200 within the boot window
the `Flows:` startup banner reports no ⚠ misauthored flows and no ERROR lines appear during boot
acceptance.verify: grep the boot log for '⚠' in the Flows banner and for ERROR-level lines; seed rejections count as failures (see #3415 — SeedLoader rejections were silent)

acceptance.clause: the console shell is served at /_console/ and the seeded app resolves
acceptance.verify: GET /api/v1/meta/app?id=<showcase appId> returns the merged app/nav metadata

history.change: initial — standing P0 smoke distilled from the dogfood boot protocol

items.title: Seeded admin can sign in through the console login page
steps: sign in with the seeded admin credentials

acceptance.clause: login succeeds and lands in the console shell
acceptance.verify: post-login screenshot shows the app shell (nav + header), not the login form
after reload, authed API calls return 200 (no redirect back to login)
acceptance.evidence: network trace of the first authed request after reload

negative: a wrong password is rejected with a visible error, not a silent no-op

items.title: Every showcase nav surface renders without page errors
steps: walk every nav destination in the showcase app (pages, list views, dashboards, reports, view gallery)
on each: wait for render, then check for pageerror / empty main / placeholder leaks

acceptance.clause: no surface throws a pageerror, renders an empty <main>, or leaks a 'no actions configured' placeholder; chart surfaces draw a real SVG
acceptance.verify: run the pinned suite: pnpm -C examples/app-showcase test:smoke (SURFACES array in e2e/showcase-smoke.spec.ts)

history.change: initial — wraps the existing automated smoke as a checklist row so runs report it alongside manual items
